meta.subject: Fix response when duplicate address check enabled

en.summary: Tightens duplicate-address response handling so lane-0 broadcast happens only for actual duplicated requests instead of for every response in duplicate-address mode.
why_it_counts: The patch fixes caller-visible response data and mask behavior in DUT RTL.
It corrects a real duplicate-address coalescing corner case rather than adding a feature.
The changed logic is small and readily reversible for fault injection.
disqualifiers: This is a follow-up fix on top of earlier duplicate-address response commits, so confidence is medium rather than high.
evidence: The only touched DUT file is hw/rtl/libs/VX_mem_streamer.sv.
drsp_mask changes from unconditional {NUM_REQS{crsp_mask[0]}} to req_dup ? broadcast_lane0 : crsp_mask.
drsp_data changes from unconditional {NUM_REQS{crsp_data[0]}} to req_dup ? broadcast_lane0 : crsp_data.
The two immediate parent commits with the same subject show this area was being corrected specifically for duplicate-address response shaping.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: This fix addresses response reconstruction after duplicate-address collapsing. When several active lanes request the same address, a memory streamer may issue only one physical request and later replicate the returned data to the suppressed duplicate lanes. That replication should happen only for requests that were actually coalesced. If the design instead broadcasts lane 0 for every response whenever duplicate-address mode is enabled, non-duplicate multi-lane responses collapse incorrectly and distinct lane results are lost.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: Duplicate-address support is enabled, but an incoming logical request contains at least one response case that is not an all-lanes-duplicate access.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Force the response path to broadcast the first lane's mask and data unconditionally whenever duplicate-address mode is compiled in.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: drop duplicate-only guard on response broadcast
portability_notes: This maps to any coalescer that conditionally expands a single returned value back to multiple requesting lanes.
The important distinction is between requests that were truly coalesced and those that merely executed while the coalescing feature was enabled.
A good trigger is a mixed multi-lane request in which duplicate-address mode is on but lanes do not all target the same address.
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the response formatter that decides whether to replicate one returned lane to multiple logical lanes after duplicate suppression.
Remove the predicate that checks whether the original request was actually a duplicate-address case.
Keep the duplication broadcast itself intact, but make it run for every response whenever the feature is enabled.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: VX_mem_streamer drsp_mask/drsp_data generation in the DUPLICATE_ADDR path
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The commit adds a req_dup guard so lane-0 broadcast is used only for true duplicate requests; otherwise drsp_mask/data pass through crsp_mask/data unchanged.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In VX_mem_streamer, remove the req_dup conditional and restore unconditional lane-0 broadcast for drsp_mask and drsp_data in duplicate-address mode.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: With duplicate-address mode enabled, non-duplicate multi-lane responses collapse to lane 0 and return the wrong masks or data to the other lanes.
evidence_for_injection: The parent revision of this exact commit broadcast crsp_mask[0] and crsp_data[0] unconditionally in the duplicate-address branch.
The fix changes only the broadcast predicate, leaving the actual broadcast machinery intact.
Two earlier commits with the same subject touched the same drsp_* logic, confirming that the bug concerned duplicate-response shaping rather than unrelated refactoring.
notes: Use the unconditional-broadcast mutation as the primary reinjection; it is cleaner and more portable than replaying the earlier intermediate broken states.
Because this is a follow-up correction in a rapidly changing area, keep confidence at medium.

zh.summary: 该提交收紧了重复地址模式下的响应处理：只有请求确实发生了重复折叠时才广播 lane 0，而不是在启用 duplicate-address 模式时对所有响应都广播 lane 0。
why_it_counts: 补丁修复的是 DUT RTL 中对调用方可见的响应数据和 mask 行为。
它修复的是重复地址合并路径中的真实边界错误，而不是新增功能。
改动很小，便于为故障注入做精确回退。
disqualifiers: 该修复是建立在前面几个同主题提交之上的后续修正，因此置信度保持为 medium。
evidence: 唯一被修改的 DUT 文件是 hw/rtl/libs/VX_mem_streamer.sv。
drsp_mask 从无条件 {NUM_REQS{crsp_mask[0]}} 改为 req_dup ? 广播 lane0 : crsp_mask。
drsp_data 从无条件 {NUM_REQS{crsp_data[0]}} 改为 req_dup ? 广播 lane0 : crsp_data。
紧邻的两个父提交具有相同 subject，表明这里确实是在连续修正 duplicate-address 响应整形逻辑。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 该修复针对的是重复地址折叠之后的响应重建逻辑。当多个有效 lane 请求同一地址时，memory streamer 可能只发出一次真实物理请求，并在返回时把结果复制给那些被抑制掉的重复 lane。这样的复制只应该发生在请求确实被折叠的情况下。如果设计只要启用了 duplicate-address 模式，就对每个响应都无条件广播 lane 0，那么那些并未发生重复折叠的多 lane 响应也会被错误压平，导致不同 lane 原本各自的数据丢失。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 重复地址折叠后的响应扩展
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: duplicate-address 支持已启用，但某个逻辑请求对应的响应并不是“所有 lane 都重复同一地址”的场景。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 只要 duplicate-address 模式被编译进来，就无条件把第一 lane 的 mask 和 data 广播给所有 lane。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 删除仅在重复请求时才广播的保护条件
portability_notes: 适用于任何在重复地址合并后需要把单一返回值重新扩展给多个逻辑请求 lane 的 coalescer。
关键在于区分“功能已启用”和“这一笔请求真的发生了重复折叠”这两件事。
一个合适的触发场景是 duplicate-address 模式开启，但多个 lane 并没有全部访问同一地址。
concrete_injection_steps: 定位响应整形逻辑中决定是否要把一个返回 lane 复制回多个逻辑 lane 的地方。
删除那个用于判断原始请求是否真的属于重复地址折叠场景的谓词。
保留广播本身的实现，但让它在功能启用时对所有响应都执行。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: VX_mem_streamer 中 DUPLICATE_ADDR 路径下的 drsp_mask/drsp_data 生成逻辑
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 该提交增加了 req_dup 条件，使 lane-0 广播只在真实重复请求时发生；否则 drsp_mask/data 直接透传 crsp_mask/data。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 VX_mem_streamer 中，删除 req_dup 条件，并把 duplicate-address 模式下的 drsp_mask 和 drsp_data 恢复为无条件广播 lane 0。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 在启用 duplicate-address 模式时，那些本不应被折叠的多 lane 响应也会被压成 lane 0 的 mask 和 data，导致其他 lane 收到错误结果。
evidence_for_injection: 该提交的父版本在 duplicate-address 分支中无条件广播 crsp_mask[0] 和 crsp_data[0]。
本次修复只改变了广播的触发谓词，而没有改动广播机制本身。
此前已有两个同主题提交连续修改同一段 drsp_* 逻辑，说明这里确实是重复响应整形缺陷而不是无关重构。
notes: 首选使用“无条件广播”这一变异方式回注入，它比复现更早的中间错误状态更干净、更易移植。
由于这里是快速迭代区域中的后续修正，置信度保持为 medium。
